features.feature: New-project primary guide file is LATTICE.md, with KOALA.md retained only as legacy compatibility input
New-project local bootstrap/wrapper paths are bin/lattice.js and bin/lattice-codex.js
New-project Codex adapter manifest path is .Codex/lattice.json, with .Codex/koala.json accepted for legacy projects
Fresh thin/full init must not generate Koala-named local wrappers/manifests by default
Existing Koala-named project assets must remain recognized and must not be silently deleted without managed ownership proof
When Lattice and Koala manifests coexist, verification prefers the Lattice primary manifest and reports drift clearly
Runtime authority stays unchanged; this story only renames managed init assets and local entrypoints
Build, smoke tests, managed asset check, and Codex adapter verification are required before DONE
